name: Narumi Seiji
source:
Owner of the Narumi Detective Agency, and [url=/c123785]Kyouka[/url]'s father. Originally a police detective, he later became an independent detective. After making a great name for himself at his field, he had unfortunately gone missing a year ago before the main story. 

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/MISSING_PARTS_the_TANTEI_STORIES]Wikipedia[/url].]
